assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Make a complete 16:9 1920x1080 game UI concept for IGA, using input 1 as the EXACT functional layout and input 2 ONLY as palette, painted anime atmosphere and material rendering reference; ignore its character and furniture. This is an ordinary student's portable smart tablet, personal and friendly, not a unique magical relic. Preserve all rectangles, navigation, whitespace and hierarchy from layout 1: ivory thin hardware body at x64,y38,w1792,h1004; dark navy bezel; screen x122,y98,w1676,h884. Camera perfectly front-on, no perspective skew. Upgrade this SVG wireframe into polished hand-painted anime game art: matte ivory ceramic/aluminum case, precise blue-grey edge, tiny teal status lamp, a modest fabric side loop and warm sunlight, soft atmospheric campus colors beyond outer corners. Screen is very clean frosted ivory/ice-blue with thin understated borders, navy typography, mint accent and one small amber highlight. Make the content read like a practical student's device, not scrapbook paper, cyberpunk, a web dashboard in a browser, or an imitation of another game's exact device. All screen content and UI ARE INCLUDED in this full concept, using the provided Chinese labels and icon shapes. No people, portraits, faces, assistants with identities, new characters, extra buttons, fake reward numbers, extra overlays, window chrome or collage. Clear thin UI surfaces, no thick focus outlines. Preserve x/y layout and text hierarchy. This master will be reconstructed in Godot with live text and native input. Overview page: keep the 6 app rail, morning greeting, student status, 0/12 collection summary and four quick-app tiles exactly as layout. Add a very small abstract three-dot service mark rather than a humanoid assistant.

Use-case: ui-mockup. Complete 16:9 IGA LOCATION SHOP COUNTER UI concept. Reference is the SVG exact functional layout. This is an on-site shop counter reached by walking to the shop in a region, NOT a tablet, NOT a personal terminal app. No sidebar navigation, no device, no online shopping. Navy readable Chinese typography, soft sage buttons, thin gray borders, tiny warm highlights, clean clear hierarchy. Preserve full reference geometry: wide top shop title/balance/return, large left product board, buy/recycle tabs and three product categories, six 3x2 product tiles; right large product detail with quantity minus/plus, total and confirmation. Six ordinary action card images can be abstract colored school activity cards, distinct no characters. Title 校园商店 · 交易柜台. Footer 交易不消耗活动次数 · 星座卡与任务道具不参与交易. No zodiac card for sale or recycle. Crisp straight-on 2D game UI, all buttons full-frame and readable.
